your_book:
Wednesday was a rough session for Jaleel's book, with the majority of holdings finishing in the red. The two heaviest positions drove much of the damage: Abbott (ABT, 10.9% weight) fell 1.75% — a meaningful drag given its size, and the mild EPS-guidance cut flag already hanging over it — while Boston Scientific (BSX, 9.2%) was the worst performer of the day, shedding 3.39%. BSX's pain compounds an already elevated risk flag: management has slashed FY26 growth guidance from 10.5% down to 7–8.5% and guided flat through Q3, making today's selloff harder to dismiss as noise. NVIDIA (NVDA, 9.2%) fell 1.59% ahead of its Q2 earnings report due today — the chip complex was broadly under pressure, and export-control scrutiny adds a second layer of uncertainty. On the bright side, Expand Energy (EXE) gained 2.02%, Neurocrine (NBIX) added 2.1%, and On Holding (ONON) picked up 1.39%, providing modest offsets.

The clearest drift — where price and thesis are diverging — sits in BSX and RKLB. BSX carries a STRONG BUY verdict with a QARP of 76.9, yet guidance has been materially cut and the stock is now slightly underwater on the position; the bullish thesis needs a concrete catalyst, not patience alone. Rocket Lab (RKLB, 6.6%) is rated AVOID with a QARP of 38.7, yet it remains a near-7% weight sitting 15.5% in the red — that combination is the most conspicuous misalignment in the book. LULU (4.2%) also continues to erode: down 1.67% today, off 9% on the position, with a guidance-cut flag and next earnings on September 2 approaching fast.

Three things to watch into the close and beyond: NVDA's Q2 print (due today) — a miss or cautious outlook on data-center spending could ripple through the book's tech exposure. LULU's September 2 report is a hard deadline on whether the Americas comp trend stabilizes. And BSX warrants close monitoring through October 20 earnings; if Q3 comes in flat as guided, the STRONG BUY case weakens further.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed + worst day in the book
attention.note: Down 3.39% today on top of an already-elevated flag (FY26 growth cut to 7–8.5%, flat Q3 guided), yet the position is rated STRONG BUY — the thesis and the fundamentals are pointing in opposite directions and need explicit reconciliation before October 20 earnings.

attention.headline: Q2 earnings due today — export controls compound the risk
attention.note: The stock fell 1.59% into the print; China export-license tightening and Senate scrutiny are live overhangs, and the outcome tonight will set the tone for the book's second-largest tech exposure.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated at 6.6% weight, down 15.5% — size vs. verdict mismatch
attention.note: A near-7% allocation to a name the model rates AVOID with a QARP of 38.7 and a deepening unrealized loss is the starkest structural inconsistency in the book; a deliberate sizing decision or an exit rationale is overdue.

attention.headline: September 2 earnings arriving with comps in freefall
attention.note: Five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin pressure, China stalled, position down 9%, and another 1.67% shed today — the upcoming report is a binary event for whether HOLD-QUAL remains defensible.
